AppStoreConnectCredentials.description: The webhook Secret, not an App Store Connect JWT/private key or IAP secret.

id.description: The notification event ID, not the related app/build/feedback resource ID.

version.description: Present in some examples, absent in background-asset notifications.

AppStoreConnectRelationship.description:
Ordinary events wrap identifiers in `data`; background-asset examples put
id/type/links directly on the relationship. Preserve both documented shapes.

scope.description: Must additionally be scoped by tenant and webhook endpoint in storage.

GithubTimestamp.description:
GitHub repository timestamps are Unix seconds in push events and strings in
other events. Preserve their wire representation rather than guessing a clock.

receivedAt.description: Server receipt time of the message, not the SSE delivery time (UTC).

endCursor.description: Position of the last returned item, or null for an empty result.

nextCursor.description: Continue in the requested direction; null when there is no next batch.

startCursor.description: Position of the first returned item, or null for an empty result.

platformData.description: Computed from decoded raw on read; never a database platform snapshot.

platformDataError.description: Present when platformData is unavailable; raw and message state remain usable.

MessageListItem.description:
HTTP list projection only, not another business message. Repositories select
these columns without loading raw headers/payloads or parsing platform data.

MessageRawResponse.description: Stored raw data, without payload parsing or platform-model projection.

contentType.description: Stored payload serialization type, not the HTTP response Content-Type.

header.description: Stored header entries, decoded only from their JSON storage representation.

payload.description: Exact raw_payload string, including JSON whitespace or form encoding.

Page_ConfigResponse.description: Wire pagination envelope, separate from the application page.

Page_MessageListItem.description: Wire pagination envelope, separate from the application page.

PlatformConfig.description:
Contains secrets: never implement Debug or use directly as an API response.
Serialize is for the caller's encrypted persistence, not public presentation.

PlatformSummary.description: Safe public projection. The mode also indicates which credentials are configured.

ReceiveResponse.description: NoMail HTTP acknowledgement. Platform controls keep their protocol response.
